verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI can query and edit large codebases (gh-1), run non-interactively for workflow automation (gh-6), and can be mentioned with @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for task delegation (gh-12, gh-23). Its GitHub integration also covers issue triage and PR review (gh-10, gh-11) and querying PRs via MCP (gh-4, gh-22), but no evidence shows an issue being turned into an opened pull request end-to-end. Hands-on reports of agentic loops, failed edits and files rewritten empty (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14) further weaken multi-step code delivery. Missing for 10: documented issue-to-PR workflow (branch, commit, PR creation), evidence that task delegation produces a finished PR, and independent corroboration of reliable end-to-end completion.
